00015 BOOL    CEquipment::EquipItem( int pos, ITEM & inItem, ITEM & outItem )
00016 {
00017         if( pos < 0 || pos >= 10 )return FALSE;
00018         //      step1: check condition fitable
00019         if( !CheckFitable( pos, inItem ) )return FALSE;
00020         //      step2: unequip old item if its exist
00021         if( m_Equipments[pos].dwMakeIndex != 0 )
00022         {
00023                 outItem.dwMakeIndex = 0;
00024                 if( !UnEquipItem( pos, outItem ) )
00025                         return FALSE;
00026         }
00027         //      step3: put in item on
00028         m_Equipments[pos] = inItem;
00029         AddPropCache( inItem );
00030         //      last: return true
00031         return TRUE;
00032 }

00034 BOOL    CEquipment::UnEquipItem( int pos, ITEM & outItem )
00035 {
00036         if( pos < 0 || pos >= 10 )return FALSE;
00037 
00038         if( m_Equipments[pos].dwMakeIndex == 0 )return FALSE;
00039         outItem = m_Equipments[pos];
00040         memset( m_Equipments+pos, 0, sizeof( ITEM ));
00041         RemovePropCache( outItem );
00042         return TRUE;
00043 }

00053 BOOL    CEquipment::CheckFitable( int pos, ITEM & inItem )
00054 {
00055         if( !VerifyPos( pos ) )return FALSE;
00056         //      step0: check pos and can equip
00057         if( !CheckStdModeFitPos( inItem.baseitem.btStdMode, pos ) )return FALSE;
00058         //      step1: check need type and need level
00059         if( !CheckNeedInfo( inItem.baseitem.needtype, inItem.baseitem.needvalue ))return FALSE;
00060         //      step2: check weight
00061         m_pErrorMsg = "Ì«ÖØÁË"; 
00062         if( pos == _U_WEAPON )
00063         {
00064                 if( inItem.baseitem.btWeight > m_pPlayer->GetPropValue(PI_MAXHANDWEIGHT))
00065                 {
00066                         return FALSE;
00067                 }
00068         }
00069         else
00070         {
00071                 int weight = CalcEquipmentsWeight( pos );
00072                 int maxweight =  (int)m_pPlayer->GetPropValue(PI_MAXBODYWEIGHT);
00073                 if( weight >= maxweight )return FALSE;
00074                 if( inItem.baseitem.btWeight + weight > maxweight )return FALSE;
00075         }
00076         //      step3: check what?( nothing to check )
00077         return TRUE;
00078 }
